shared_elements: animals (horned/ram-like in A; small animal offerings in B)
justification: Both surfaces depict profile human figures in shallow relief organized into horizontal registers, and both involve animals in what reads as a bringing/offering context, but these are generic correspondences. A shows a continuous procession of striding attendants leading large horned rams past a stylized tree, framed by rosette borders, whereas B is a rounded-top panel dominated by dense columns of script signs with small seated/kneeling figures at tables, an entirely different compositional scheme and figure convention.
